Point2.description: A sketch point in mm: [x, y] or {"x", "y"}.

SketchTarget.description: The sketch: its feature id or its name (default: the one being edited).

SlotWidth.description: The slot's width in mm: more than 0.000000001 and below 1 000 000 000.

input.description:
Draw a slot from its centre and the centre of one end arc; the other end is the mirror
image. Four tangent constraints and an equal one hold it.

center.description: The slot's centre, [x, y] in mm.

connect.description: Join the new points to the existing points they land on. Default: true.

end.description: The centre of one end arc, [x, y] in mm; the other end is its mirror image through `center`.

sketch.description: The sketch (default: the one being edited).

input.title: SlotCenterPointParams

label: Center Point Slot

Created.description: What a command added to its sketch: the ids that the sketch has now and did not before.

constraints.description: Constraint ids, dimensions not among them.

wires.description: The ids of 3D curves, when the command made any.

output.description: What a straight slot returns, including its construction centre and middle point.

constraints.description:
The ids of the constraints added besides the curves' own: a coincident for a point that
landed on an existing one, a point on the curve for a point that was given by id, a radius
for a size given as an expression, what `infer` added.

created.description:
Everything the call added to the sketch: `{points, curves, constraints, dimensions}`, and
`wires` when there are any.

curves.description: The ids of the curves drawn, in order.

param_warnings.description: In the warn parameter-check mode: what the call's parameters got wrong.

output.title: SlotResult

params: center: slot centre, end: one arc centre, width; returns centre_line and middle. Returns created: {points, curves, constraints, dimensions}: the ids of what it added (stable and never reused: usable right away in sketch.dimension, sketch.constraint.*, sketch.delete…)
